name: Project WAND
source:
Play as Alexis, an initiate mage at the Travelling Tower, a centre for magical arts and learning, but magic is sort of a secondary concern for her... can you hardly blame her when every single girl at the Tower is super cute, or hot, or both...? And now they're her dorm mates too??

[From [url=https://sytochan.itch.io/project-wand-vn]itch.io[/url]]
